design.censor_rule: After first timeout for a method/contract/batch, mark all remaining attempts for that key notrun_due_to_prespecified_censor; do not replace inputs. Other keys continue.
design.timed: Native MetricComputor constructor plus recompute(True), including dataset/results/score/optional-metrics CSV reads, default three metrics, final results.csv write/close, and one wall-clock deadline arming call. Deadline-handler setup and cleanup are outside the interval.
design.excluded: Imports, source/input hash audits, environment/log setup, metric-object creation, tiny JIT warmup, trial-template copying/filtering, post-run parity audit and summaries. No cold-disk/fsync/training claim.
design.all_observed_semantics: Native unique-score queries except the minimum, native synthetic first/last points, >= eligibility, lexsort and trapezoidal integration; only max_samples is configured to infinity.
design.query_accounting: Read-only native score distinct counts and exact source-sampler query counts are frozen per profile/contract. max_samples=50 is nominal, not a hard cap. Constant-score profiles would use the native zero shortcut without curve evaluation.
design.uncertainty: Six paired orders of fixed workloads; approximate paired-order bootstrap intervals describe execution variability and order sensitivity, not recording or deployment populations. No cross-contract speed ratios. No interval without all six completed matched pairs.
design.order_of_work: contracts in declared order, combined batch then sorted families, six method permutations per batch
design.comparison_scope: Supplemental comparison of three compiled implementations on the same native default-three-metric recalculation. The interval method rebuilds predicted runs and traverses ordered interval overlaps with closed-form positional masses for every query. Raster and bucket are the frozen compiled controls. The public range method is not executed or relabeled; native ROC_AUC and PR_AUC remain unchanged.
design.output_parity_scope: All completed compiled outputs are compared within the same contract and batch at absolute tolerance 1e-10. Public-reference flags retained by the original orchestration are always false. This supplemental study alone supplies no public-implementation parity evidence.
